$comment: Accepted metric regressions for the release gate (bench/gates.py, bench/run.py --gate). Each entry: metric (a summary key of bench/report.py METRICS / SEQ_METRICS), scenario, optional config and solver (fnmatch patterns, default *), the ADR that justifies the change (docs/adr/<adr>-*.md; entries without an existing ADR are ignored) and a reason. Example: {"metric": "placed_rate", "scenario": "05-airports", "config": "*", "solver": "rust", "adr": "0018", "reason": "..."}
